how_to_apply: Visit the official website, www.pgimer.edu.in, and use the Recruitment link on the home page.
Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number (required for the initial registration and kept active throughout the process).

Fill in mandatory registration details - Advertisement No., Advertisement Date, Name (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth, Mobile No. & Email ID - carefully, as these cannot be changed once registered.
Log in with the User ID and password sent to your email/mobile, and complete the section-wise Application Form: personal information, qualification(s), experience(s), and document uploads.

Upload a scanned photograph in JPG/JPEG format (50–80 KB), snapped on or after 1 June 2026, with the candidate's name and the date of the photograph clearly visible; no cap or goggles (spectacles allowed); the photograph should be unattested.

Upload legible scanned copies of all required certificates (educational qualification from Matric onwards, date of birth, category certificate, experience certificates, NOC from present employer if applicable).
Submit the form and complete payment via Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card only.

Take a printout of the submitted application form for your records. Candidates already in government/semi-government/autonomous body employment must also forward their application through proper channel to the Administrative Officer, Recruitment Cell, within 10 days of the closing date.
important_instructions: Candidature is purely provisional at all stages; candidates not meeting the eligibility conditions will be cancelled at any stage without notice. All updates - corrigenda, CBT notice, CBT result, eligibility notice, provisional result, interview schedule, document verification schedule, and final result - will be posted only on www.pgimer.edu.in; no individual intimation will be sent. No entries in the Registration Form or Application Form can be changed once submitted; incorrect entries may lead to rejection with no scope for reconsideration. Candidates should not bring water bottles, car key remotes, chains, mobile phones, pagers, pens, wrist watches, rings, wallets, purses, or any electronic device into the examination hall. Roll numbers/admit cards are available for download roughly one week before the exam and will not be sent by post. There is no provision for re-checking/re-evaluation of the CBT, and question papers/answer keys are not provided to candidates, though objections on specific questions may be emailed to [email protected] within 3 days of the exam. Candidates in employment must forward their application through proper channel within 10 days of the closing date; a No Objection Certificate is mandatory for departmental candidates. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant, and use of unfair means or impersonation may lead to criminal prosecution and permanent debarment. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Chandigarh Courts alone.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Chandigarh Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by an interview only for Group "A" posts. The CBT is in English only, held on an all-India basis at the notified examination cities. Each question carries 1 mark, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for General/EWS and 35% for SC/ST/OBC (separately for CBT and interview); reserved-category candidates applying against an unreserved post must secure 40%. For Group B & C (Non-Gazetted) posts, the Government of India has dispensed with the interview, so selection is based on CBT merit only. For Group A posts, there is a 15-mark interview in addition to the CBT. Shortlisting for document verification is done at 3 times the number of advertised posts (plus ties) where no skill test is prescribed, or 5 times the number of posts (plus ties) where a skill test is prescribed. Final selection is based on CBT marks only for Group B & C, and on CBT + interview marks for Group A. Tie cases are resolved first by fewer wrong answers/negative marks, then by earlier date of birth, then by higher aggregate percentage in 10+2, then by higher percentage in Matriculation. Examination cities (tentative): Amritsar, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Chandigarh/Mohali, Dehradun, Delhi/NCR, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Jammu, Kolkata, Lucknow, Patna, and Shimla. The city of examination, once chosen and allotted, cannot be changed.

faq.question: Q1. What is PGIMER Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive for 60 posts - 57 Group C posts at PGIMER, Chandigarh, and 3 posts of Group A, B & C at PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur, Punjab - under Advertisement No. PGI/RC/053/2026/2192.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: 60 posts in total: Library Attendant Grade-I (1), Animal Attendant (1), Barber (1), Multi Tasking Staff Sanitation Grade-III (54) at PGIMER Chandigarh; and Medical Officer (1), Computer Programmer (1), Pharmacist Grade-II (1) at PGI Satellite Centre, Sangrur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PGIMER Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 19 October 2026 is the closing date for online registration and submission of applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: It varies by post - from Matriculation (Barber, Multi Tasking Staff, Animal Attendant) to a Diploma/Degree (Pharmacist, Library Attendant, Computer Programmer) to a medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act (Medical Officer). See the Eligibility table above for post-wise detail.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PGIMER Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18–30 years for most posts, and 18–35 years for Computer Programmer, as on the closing date (19.10.2026), with category-wise relaxation as detailed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹1,500 (General/OBC/EWS) or ₹800 (SC/ST), plus transaction charges; PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for PGIMER Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only online at www.pgimer.edu.in from 3 September to 19 October 2026. See the "How to Apply" section above for the full step-by-step process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for PGIMER Chandigarh posts?
faq.answer: A Computer Based Test (CBT) for all posts, plus an interview only for the Group A post (Medical Officer). Group B and C posts are selected on CBT merit alone, since interviews have been dispensed with for these posts.
